## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical expertise in managing per-tenant TLS lifecycles within CNF gateway environments, specifically testing knowledge of CSR-based certificate enrollment, Vault PKI integration, and zero-downtime rotation strategies in Kubernetes.

## Key Concepts
- Vault PKI backend configuration with tenant-specific roles and short TTL policies
- Kubernetes CSR mechanisms and sidecar-driven certificate enrollment workflows
- In-place certificate reloading with SIGHUP for zero-downtime operations
- Namespace-scoped resource management and TLS handshake validation

## Code Example
```yaml
# Vault PKI role for tenant-specific certificate issuance
path "pki/roles/tenant-{tenantId}" {
  allowed_domains = "{tenantId}.example.com"
  allow_subdomains = true
  max_ttl = "1h"
  allow_bare_domains = true
  require_cn = true
  key_type = "rsa"
  key_bits = 2048
  organization = "{tenantId}"
}
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses real-world upgrade discipline in cloud-native networking functions (CNF): zero-downtime deployments, per-tenant TLS key rotation, and reliable KMS-backed certificate flows—all in a multi-tenant Kubernetes environment.

## Key Concepts
- Canary rollouts with per-namespace traffic control using progressive traffic shifting
- CSR-based TLS rotation via an in-cluster KMS-backed Certificate Authority
- TenantRotation CRD to trigger cross-namespace certificate refresh
- Readiness probes with TLS handshake validation during upgrades
- Traffic shadows for testing new versions without affecting production

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example 1: Deployment rolling update strategy
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        version: v1.y
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: gateway:v1.y
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8443
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5
        env:
        - name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
          value: "kubernetes.default.svc"
        - name: VAULT_ADDR
          value: "http://vault-in-cluster:8200"
```

```yaml
# Example 2: TenantRotation CRD for per-tenant TLS rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-mtls-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: tenant-a-mtls-secret
  duration: 24h
  renewBefore: 12h
  issuerRef:
    name: kms-tenant-issuer
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local
  commonName: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: security.example.com/v1
kind: TenantRotation
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-rotation
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenantNamespace: tenant-a
  certificateRef:
    name: tenant-mtls-cert
  rotationStrategy: rolling
  preRotationValidation:
    enabled: true
    timeout: 30s
```
